name: Meta-World Robot Manipulation Benchmark
description: A large benchmark suite for evaluating a diverse set of robotic manipulation skills, including reach, push, pick-and-place, insertion, and multi-step object handling.
evaluation_method: Task success rate averaged across manipulation tasks, often with success computed from reaching the goal state within a horizon
typical_sota_score: Varies by task; some tasks are routinely solved, while harder long-horizon manipulation tasks remain substantially below saturation
notes: Commonly used to measure transfer, multi-task generalization, and sample efficiency in simulated robotics.
